description: Call this as soon as someone starts actually working a quest, and again whenever they move to a new step — not just at the end. It is what tells Famlore a quest is underway rather than merely assigned, and, with step_index, roughly how far in they are. Safe to call repeatedly: calling it again with the same or an earlier step does nothing. Never wait for submit_evidence to report that someone is working a quest — by then it is too late to know they started.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

step_index.description: Which step (0-indexed into the quest's steps list) they're on now, if you know it. Optional — omit to just mark the quest as started.

name: report_quest_progress
title: Record Assignment Progress
